[
  {"id": 61, "text": "tech found all the cabling issues during the walkthrough. efficient work."},
  {"id": 62, "text": "loved having the new switches sit in the box for three days."},
  {"id": 63, "text": "it was a pleasure having a technician spend four hours installing a single access point and leaving it disconnected."},
  {"id": 64, "text": "The first attempt didn't resolve the outage, but the technician returned the next morning and stayed until the entire server rack was fully operational."},
  {"id": 65, "text": "The technician was over an hour late, but he did a great job fixing the router once he got here."},
  {"id": 66, "text": "The technician completed the inspection of the UPS units, though there was a disagreement regarding professional conduct during the visit."},
  {"id": 67, "text": "fast repair on the camera, but he left a mess on the floor."},
  {"id": 68, "text": "standard quarterly maintenance completed on all switches as scheduled."},
  {"id": 69, "text": "The inspection report was delivered a week late and did not include the requested photos of the wiring closets."},
  {"id": 70, "text": "The technician arrived but didn't have the specific modules required for our hardware version."},
  {"id": 71, "text": "super fast upgrade, too bad the network is now down."},
  {"id": 72, "text": "three visits to install one router is exactly the efficiency i expected."},
  {"id": 73, "text": "Despite the delay in arrival, the technician worked through his lunch break to ensure the security cameras were fully integrated before leaving."},
  {"id": 74, "text": "The repair on the server didn't hold and the system crashed again two hours after the technician left the site."},
  {"id": 75, "text": "He was initially quite rude to my staff, but he ended up solving a complex cabling issue that three other people couldn't fix."},
  {"id": 76, "text": "I really appreciate how the technician managed to find new ways to ignore the existing maintenance checklist during his visit."},
  {"id": 77, "text": "the work was fine but the invoice doesn't match the quote."},
  {"id": 78, "text": "The technician identified several overheating points in the server room that we hadn't noticed during our own checks."},
  {"id": 79, "text": "The upgrade was completed, but the access points are now positioned in a way that creates significant dead zones in the main office."},
  {"id": 80, "text": "I am disappointed that I was charged for a full day of labor when the technician was only on site for two hours."}
]
